title: EBI-Metagenomics/metaviraverse pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

id.description: For catalogue data: catalogueName_version, example, tomato-rhizosphere_1.0. For assembly data: ERZ accession
id.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fna.errorMessage: FASTA file corresponding to GFF with viral sequences

faa.description: Path to protein FASTA (.faa) for structure prediction. Optional — subworkflow skipped if absent.
faa.errorMessage: FASTA file corresponding to GFF with protein sequences

source.description: Use 'genome' for MAG or isolate; use 'metagenome' for assembly

pdb_dir.description: Directory of pre-computed PDB files (e.g. from nf-core/proteinfold). Optional — ESMFold runs if absent.
pdb_dir.errorMessage: Path to directory containing .pdb files for structural annotation
